notes.title: Update 1.0.26 is now available!
notes.content:
Update 1.0.26 has been released and will be downloaded when your Steam Client is restarted.

[h1]Changes in 1.0.26:[/h1]
[*] Added an in-game options menu with mouse sensitivity slider.
[*] Minor text fixes.
[*] Fixed a bug where the game would reset to windowed mode when loading a new scene if the user never applied any changes to the options menu.

notes.title: Update 1.0.20 is now available.
notes.content:
Update 1.0.20 has been released and will be downloaded when your Steam Client is restarted.

[h1]Changes in 1.0.20:[/h1]
[*] Added Trading Cards!
[*] Reduced size of bullets, for more accurate hit detection.
[*] Infected will now occasionally duck left or right to make landing headshots more challenging.
[*] Added extra light in Denisov Cave to help with navigation.

notes.title: Update 1.0.14 Out Now!
notes.content:
Update 1.0.14 has been released and will be downloaded when your Steam Client is restarted (if it hasn't already).

[h1]Changes in 1.0.14:[/h1]
[*] Concentrated Infected spawn points to increase difficulty.
[*] Reduced Grenade cook time.
[*] Added 'Controls' option in the main menu.
[*] Reduced total ammo amount per contract to increase difficulty.
[*] Increased Infected spawn counts for larger contracts (Camp/Compound).
[*] The door of the lift in Denisov Cave has been made lighter so that it opens easier.
[*] Infected in Horde Mode now behave correctly, swarming towards the player in large numbers.
[*] Fixed white graphical glitch in the lift shaft of Denisov Cave.
